title: Extractive Signature, Exact-Match Disablement, and a Limited Boycott Statement by Independent Entities
creator: Lee Sharks · Ayanna Vox · Damascus Dancings · Nobel Glas
description:
A v1.0 forensic/provenance packet by Lee Sharks, Ayanna Vox, Damascus Dancings, and Nobel Glas classifying Brave Search as **evarB**, the sixth platform in the archive’s Extractive Signatures taxonomy. The report analyzes eight source-preserved June 4, 2026 query artifacts involving Lee Sharks, *Pearl and Other Poems*, Johannes Sigil, and Provenance Erasure Rate.

The packet names operator nullification, silent autocorrection, disambiguation inversion, terminological pre-emption, referential collapse, and institutional traffic conversion. It applies the archive’s v3 measurement program and reports near-total provenance erasure and strongly power-oriented dispersal. It concludes with a limited boycott statement and five demands, led by restoration of enforceable exact-match search, and invites co-signatures from independent entities. The artifacts, calculations, and platform-design interpretations are claims of the deposited audit, not independently reproduced findings in this DW pass.
